title.zh: 完成 Truman Town 未完成模块及证据刷新
title.en: Complete Truman Town Planned Modules and Evidence Refresh

intent.zh: 将已实现遗物能力绑定到 Normify，并补齐 AI 护栏、记忆嵌入与摘要及沙盘 Viewer 的可验证实现，同时刷新漂移源码指纹。
intent.en: Bind existing relic capabilities to Normify and implement verifiable AI guard, memory embedding and summary, and sandbox viewer features while refreshing drifted source fingerprints.

acceptance: All six planned leaf contracts are implemented or evidence-bound to existing implementation; no placeholder contract is activated without code and tests.
Normify source fingerprints match current source files and repoRoot validation has zero errors.
Focused tests and full npm test pass.
normify-truman-town artifacts are rebuilt and rendered.
Scoped changes are committed and pushed to origin/main without including unrelated working-tree changes.
note: 已实现并测试 AI Guard、记忆 embedding/summary、Viewer；将既有 relic artifact/discover 绑定到实际源码并激活；刷新44个既有指纹漂移模块。repoRoot 校验0 errors，保留297条依赖未锚定与Viewer双文件叶子过粗warning。全量 npm test 已运行至长耗时 integration #49 通过，但执行环境未产生最终汇总文件；定向测试23/23通过。
